title: 3D model to pixelart with claude
author: thewokelama
selftext:
Decided I wanted a snowy mountain in one of my game regions. Had an idea to use a 3D model. Gave glb file to claude with some prompts on art style. Within moments it churned out a large mountain area that now occupies considerable space in my game world. If Im building another game in pixelart style this is the only method I would follow. Take pictures, use 3D models of real world areas to make the world building easier. Saves time making tilesets, assets etc. Helps you focus more time in other areas. Also make bigger open worlds. Sky is the limit. Have fun:)
